text:
Type: large woven storage basket
Use: storing blankets, magazines or toys on a floor or a shelf; living room, bedroom, home office
Style: Scandinavian, coastal, minimalist
Materials: open-woven flat strips of off-white fiber, reinforced top band with small metal rivets
Colors: off-white, natural cream
Shape: square tapered basket with a wide open top, a loose checkered weave with small gaps along the upper rows, sturdy flat rim, roomy and light
Feel: airy, fresh, natural, practical
Goes with: light wood, white shelving, linen throws, pale walls; Scandinavian or coastal rooms

product.name: KNARRA
product.description: Collecting newspapers, toys, hats and gloves in baskets makes it easier to find what you need and keeps the room looking neat and uncluttered.
